t: Kublai Khan proclaimed the Yuan Dynasty in 1271, making China the centre of the Mongol world and ruling it from Dadu (Beijing).
It linked China to Persia and Europe across the Mongol network, and its rigid ethnic hierarchy put southern Chinese at the bottom.
Floods, epidemics, runaway paper-money inflation and the Red Turban Rebellion brought it down; the Ming took Dadu in 1368.
dyk: Kublai's Tibetan preceptor Phagpa devised a new script in 1269 to write all the empire's languages; it appeared on seals and coins but never caught on.
ev: Kublai's claim to be Great Khan sparks civil war with his brother Ariq Böke
